Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-MD) wants Sen. Chuck Schumer’s (D-NY) job. Ahead of the December 1 vote to choose Senate Democrats’ next leader, Van Hollen joins Astead Herndon to explain why he’s challenging Schumer, whether he has the votes to win, and what would actually change under his leadership.
